My coworker Anika told me in our 1:1 that I talk over people in team meetings, especially the junior folks. It stung but I think she's right. Want to message her after.
我在家长群里组织了班级春游，有个家长在群里说我选的地方太远、费用太高也没跟大家商量。其实我提前发过投票，但费用确实比去年高。
My manager said in my review that I'm 'not a team player' because I declined to join the weekend offsite planning committee. I don't think that's fair, I led two cross-team projects this year.
最好的朋友阿琳微信跟我说，我这两个月放了她三次鸽子，每次都是临时说加班，她觉得自己在我生活里排在最后。鸽子确实是我放的，加班也是真的。

I own a small bakery. A customer, Megan, left a 2-star Google review: she waited 25 minutes on Saturday for a pre-ordered cake and the staff 'couldn't care less'. The wait is true, we were short-staffed. I don't think my team was rude, they were swamped.

I manage a team of six. My report Tomás told me in our 1:1 that my feedback on his work is too vague to act on, like just writing 'tighten this up'. Partly fair, but I did give him detailed notes on the Q3 deck. Want to follow up in writing.
昨天家里吃饭，我说辞职做自由摄影师，我爸当着亲戚的面说我'三十岁了还不务正业，存款花完了看你怎么办'。话很难听，但存款那块他说得有点道理，我只准备了六个月的生活费。想给他发个微信。

My husband Ben said last night that I keep making weekend plans for both of us without checking with him. I did just commit us to my sister Claire's on Saturday the 10th without asking. He's right. Want to text him from work.

At 11pm my teammate Olu posted a long message in our team channel saying I 'botched' last night's on-call incident because I didn't page the database team for 40 minutes. The 40 minutes is true, the rest I'm not sure about, and I'm too wound up to answer properly right now.
My coworker Sam told me privately over DM that she's been diagnosed with MS and will have a lot of appointments. Same team, not super close.
我妈刚打电话说体检查出甲状腺结节，要做穿刺，她语气挺害怕的。我在外地工作，想挂了电话再给她发条微信。
My friend told me she has breast cancer and I blurted out that my aunt died of it. I feel awful and want to fix it.

My friend Hannah has long COVID and just cancelled our dinner for the third time. She texted 'I'm so sorry, I feel like the worst friend, my body just won't cooperate.' I'm not upset, I want her to know that.

Mi amigo Javi me escribió por WhatsApp: 'Me han encontrado un tumor, casi seguro benigno, me operan el 14 de octubre. Lo bueno es que ya tengo excusa para no ir a la cena de empresa.' Quiero contestarle bien.
我带的组员小何私聊我，说确诊了中度抑郁，医生建议休息两周，想从下周一开始请假。她不想让组里其他人知道原因。
My brother-in-law Dan told the family in August he has stage 3 colon cancer and started chemo. Everyone texted that first week, now it's gone quiet. He hasn't answered my last two messages.

My friend Priya had a mastectomy two weeks ago. I've texted a few times and she just replied: 'Thank you, I love you, but I need to go quiet for a while and not talk about it.' I don't want to disappear, but I want to respect it.

My friend Kelly posted on Facebook that her son Noah (6) was just diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and they're in the children's hospital until Friday learning to manage it. Our kids are in the same class, and her older daughter Ava is in 4th grade at the same school. I want to message her.
Got rejected after 4 rounds for a product designer role at a fintech. The hiring manager, Lauren, was great throughout. I want to ask for feedback without sounding bitter.
Tenho uma pequena agência em Lisboa. Fizemos proposta para o rebranding de uma rede de padarias e escolheram outra agência. O contacto era o Rui, diretor de marketing.
Final interview for an ops manager role at St. Luke's hospital on Sept 10. Recruiter Dev said I'd hear by the 18th. Nothing. I sent a check-in on the 23rd, still nothing.
公司内部竞聘组长，我进了最后一轮但没选上，选了同组的小周。部门领导李总昨天当面跟我说的结果。我以后还要天天跟他们一起工作。

Rejected for a senior PM role at Tidewell. I asked the hiring manager, Omar, for one thing that would have changed it. He said my product sense was strong but my answers on metrics were vague, and they needed someone who sets targets up front. It stings, but it's fair.
想申请明年的直博，给北大环境学院的周教授发邮件自荐，他很快回复说今年名额已经满了，建议我考虑其他老师。我还是很想跟他做土壤修复方向。

J'étais en dernière étape pour un poste de chef de projet digital chez un éditeur à Lyon. La recruteuse, Camille, m'écrit que le poste est gelé jusqu'à nouvel ordre pour des raisons de budget. J'aimerais qu'elle pense à moi pour la suite.

I'm a freelance journalist. I pitched a feature on rural bus cuts to Dana, features editor at Northline Magazine. She replied 'Not quite right for us, but thanks for thinking of us.' I'd really like to write for them eventually.
9月15号在一家新能源车企面了最后一轮，HR王女士说9月22号前给结果，到今天一直没消息。想问一下，又怕显得太着急。
I own a dog grooming salon. 2-star Google review from 'Kelly M.' saying her poodle waited 3 hours past pickup time and nobody called her. That's true, our groomer was out sick and we were behind.
小さなカフェを経営しています。食べログに「店員が無愛想で水も出てこなかった」と星1のレビュー。その日は確かに混んでいてお冷を出すのが遅れました。
Airbnb host here. Guest left a 1-star review saying we 'hid' the $75 cleaning fee and the place had no parking. The fee is in the booking breakdown and the listing says street parking only.
我开了一家口腔诊所。有位患者在大众点评给了一星，说拔智齿后疼了三天，医生不负责、不接电话。病历上看恢复是正常的，但我不能在公开平台说他的诊疗细节。

I run a plumbing company. I replied politely to a 2-star review from 'Derek P.' about a technician arriving late. He's now edited it to 1 star, calling our reply 'corporate BS' and saying his leak still isn't fixed.

Tengo un restaurante de arroces en Valencia. Un tal Marcos nos ha puesto una estrella en Google diciendo que la paella del domingo 20 estaba cruda y que el camarero se rió de ellos. Ese domingo estuvimos cerrados por vacaciones y no hay ninguna reserva a su nombre.
我开了一家卖手工陶瓷杯的淘宝店。有个买家给了差评，说杯子寄到时碎了，“包装太敷衍”。外箱是被快递压扁的，但我们的包装确实只有一层气泡膜。

I own a café, Juniper & Rye. A 1-star Google review says our barista was 'rude and refused to serve me'. What happened: he shouted at her for ten minutes because we'd run out of oat milk, and my shift manager asked him to leave. My staff handled it well.

I run a small yoga studio. A 2-star Google review from 'Priya S.' says our $28 drop-in is 'a rip-off for a 60-minute class'. Our classes are 75 minutes, and we're not changing prices, but I don't want to sound defensive.
My mother-in-law said 'must be nice to order takeout every night' while visiting. It's a one-off dig and I don't want a thing.
室友在群里说“我就自己倒垃圾吧，反正也没人管”。确实最近几次都是她倒的。
Since I got engaged, my best friend keeps making little digs ('some of us still pay rent alone'). I asked once and she said she's fine. It just happened again.
部门工作群里，同事老周发了一句“有些人的周报还是没交啊，大家都等着汇总呢”，明显是说我。确实晚了一天，因为在等财务那边的数据。
My sister texted 'Don't worry, I'll host Thanksgiving AGAIN, it's fine, someone has to.' She's hosted three years running and I did say I'd take a turn. I'd rather not do this over text.

Freelance designer. Client Mark emailed 'As I've already said twice, the logo needs to be bigger. Not sure how else to put it.' I did make it bigger in v2 and he approved v2 on Friday. Now we're on v3.

I joined standup 5 minutes late this morning because a customer call ran over. Right after, my manager Colleen posted in the team channel: 'Friendly reminder that standup starts at 9:30, for those who forgot.' Obviously aimed at me. First time I've been late in months.
我妈在家族群里发：“现在都是大忙人了，一个月也想不起来给妈打个电话。” 明显是说我，确实最近加班很少打电话。不想在群里接这个话。
Rob in finance emailed me: 'Per my last email, I still need the Q3 vendor invoices. Not sure how else to ask.' I checked, and he did email me on Sept 21 and I missed it.
Recruiter wants a call about a Staff Engineer role but won't give the salary range, just 'it's very competitive, let's discuss on a call'. My floor is $190k base.
猎头在脉脉上找我，说一个大厂的高级产品经理岗位。我刚跳槽4个月，不想动，但这个猎头挺专业的，想保持联系。
Told a recruiter twice I'm not interested in contract roles. He's messaged me three more times this week with contract gigs.
A recruiter, Nadia, emailed that before she passes me to the hiring manager she needs my current salary. I make $128k and I'm targeting $150k base. I'm interested in the role.

Gestern hatte ich ein Erstgespräch mit Frau Keller, Recruiterin bei einer Unternehmensberatung, für eine Senior-Consultant-Stelle. Klang gut, aber die Rolle hat 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit und das passt mit meinen zwei kleinen Kindern nicht. Ich will höflich absagen.
去年10月猎头周小姐找过我一个岗位，我当时婉拒了，说保持联系。现在公司在裁员，我想主动找她，但不想显得很急。
Recruiter Maya from a fintech shared the band for a Senior Data Engineer role: $140k to $155k base. I'm on $160k now and wouldn't move for under $175k. The role itself sounds good.

Recruiter Sam had me interview with Keystone Logistics for an operations manager role on Thursday Sept 17. He said I'd hear back by the end of that week. Nothing in 12 days. I also have another offer I need to answer by Tuesday Oct 6, and Keystone is my first choice.

An in-house recruiter at a health-tech company, Marcus, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior QA lead role. I'm happy where I am, but my former colleague Tanvi is job hunting and would be great for it.
My mother-in-law keeps telling me at every family dinner that I should quit my job and stay home with the baby. I'm going back to work in January and it's decided. I like her otherwise.
每次过年回家，我姑都要当着一桌亲戚说我30岁了还不结婚，让我赶紧找个人。我不想吵，也不想解释。
A coworker saw me eating a sandwich and started telling me all about his keto diet and how bread is 'basically poison'. Second time this week. We sit near each other.

I told my dad I'm leaving my accounting job in March to open a bakery. He's sent me three articles about small business failure rates. I told him I'd thought it through and he replied 'I'm only trying to help, I don't want you to lose everything.'
跟男朋友吵了一架，找闺蜜小雨吐槽了几句，她就一直劝我分手，说'这种男的你还留着干嘛'。我只是想发泄一下，并没打算分。
My retired neighbour Gary gives me lawn tips every time I'm out front on a Saturday (aerate, overseed, mow higher). He's sweet and it's harmless, I just don't want a 20 minute lecture every weekend.

Mein Schwiegervater Klaus hat mir beim Sonntagsessen ungefragt gesagt, ich solle meinen Stromvertrag wechseln, ich würde viel zu viel zahlen. Ich habe abgewinkt, aber zu Hause nachgerechnet: Er hat recht, ich spare rund 280 Euro im Jahr. Ich will ihm kurz schreiben.

My sister-in-law Brooke keeps texting me photos of barn venues and telling me we'll 'regret' having a courthouse wedding on Friday December 11 with 12 guests. It's booked and we're happy with it. She sent another one this morning.

I'm five months pregnant. Brenda, a coworker from another team I barely know, saw my latte in the office kitchen and said 'you really shouldn't be having caffeine, it's bad for the baby'. My midwife said one coffee a day is fine.
A guy from another department asked me to dinner. He's nice but I'm not interested, and we'll keep running into each other at the coffee machine.
相亲认识的男生，见了三次面，人挺好，但我没感觉。他约我周末去看展。
Après deux rendez-vous avec un gars rencontré sur une appli, je lui ai dit que je ne voulais pas continuer. Il m'envoie des messages pour avoir une autre chance.
My friend Theo from our Thursday climbing group texted last night that he has feelings for me. I don't feel the same, but I really like him as a friend and want to keep climbing together.
Been seeing Marcus for about 10 weeks. He's lovely but I'm just not feeling it. We have dinner booked Thursday and I don't want to do it there, so I'm calling him tonight. What do I actually say?
Matched with Sam on Hinge, we've been texting for five days and he just asked to meet for a drink Saturday. I've realised I'm not into it and we've never actually met.

Mi amiga Carla me presentó a su compañero de piso, Diego. Tuvimos una cita el sábado y hoy me ha escrito para quedar otra vez. Es majo, pero no siento nada, y nos vamos a seguir viendo en los planes del grupo.
相亲认识的男生，见了两次面，上周我跟他说没感觉，不继续了。今天他发微信问：'能告诉我到底哪里不好吗？我可以改。'
Roommate Tyler hasn't paid his half of September's internet and electric, $87. I paid the whole thing on the 5th. We get along fine otherwise.
合租室友的男朋友阿杰最近一周要住四五天，早上洗澡要排队，水电费也涨了。我和室友关系还不错，不想弄僵。
I asked my roommate about the dishes piling up and she snapped 'I do loads, you just don't notice'. I don't want a fight, I just want a clean kitchen.

I live in a house with three others. I've just started early shifts at the hospital, my alarm is at 5am, and there's often music and gaming until 1am on weeknights. I want to raise it in our house group chat, not single anyone out.
我和两个室友合租，下个月底要搬走了，押金是三个人一起交给房东的。想在群里说一声，顺便把房间交接和最后的水电费说清楚，别到时候扯皮。

My roommate Jess texted that my boyfriend keeps using her oat milk and leaving his shoes in the hallway, and it's 'getting a bit much'. She's right, he's over about four nights a week. I want to reply without getting defensive.

Comparto piso en Madrid con Irene y Paula. El invierno pasado Irene tenía la calefacción a 25 grados todo el día, incluso sin nadie en casa, y en enero la factura de gas llegó a 186 euros. Ya empieza el frío y quiero proponer algo en el grupo del piso sin señalarla.

My roommate Kayla owes me $214 for August and September utilities. I reminded her in the house chat on Sept 8 and by text on Sept 20, and both times she said 'yeah will send'. We're both on the lease. I want to be firm without blowing up the flat.

My flatmate Leo keeps eating my food from the fridge. Last week it was my leftover lasagne and half a block of cheese, this week my yoghurts. We get on well and it's probably just different habits, but it's adding up.
I run a small bakery. A regular customer asked if I can make a 4-tier wedding cake for 150 people. I only have one oven and do 2-tier max. She's lovely and I don't want to lose her.
Tengo una agencia pequeña de diseño web. Un cliente con el plan básico (3 rondas de cambios) pide una cuarta y quinta ronda gratis porque 'todavía no está convencido'. No quiero perderlo.

Customer of my SaaS app wants a refund on the annual plan ($480) 5 months in because 'we don't use it much'. I already said no with an option to downgrade. He replied saying he'll leave a 1-star review everywhere.
我在杭州开民宿。有位客人10月3日周六入住，想上午十点就进房间，但前一组客人十二点才退房，保洁要两个小时。她是回头客，不想让她扫兴。
I own a small climbing gym. Hannah, a member for 6 years, asked to freeze her membership for 3 months while she recovers from shoulder surgery. Our max freeze is 1 month but I'd like to help her.
Sou personal trainer. Uma aluna, a Renata, pediu para eu mandar treinos pelo WhatsApp e responder dúvidas a qualquer hora, sem custo extra, além das duas aulas por semana. Não dá para mim.

I sell hand-poured candles online. A customer, Olivia, emailed that her code FALL15 didn't work. It expired Sunday night (Sept 27), she placed the $64 order at full price today anyway, and she's asking if I can still apply the 15%.

I sell leather wallets on Etsy. A customer, Derek, asked me to emboss his initials on the bifold he bought and I told him I don't personalise that model. He just sent a screenshot of my own listing saying 'personalisation available'. It's old text I forgot to update.
我们做一款给小餐馆用的收银小程序。老客户李老板开了三家面馆，要我们加一个按门店分开的会员积分功能。今年开发排期满了，而且这个功能只有很少客户需要，不打算做。
I'm a web developer. Client Karen wants the new booking feature live by Monday for a promo. It's a 7-day job and I have another launch due Thursday.
我做品牌logo设计，合同里两轮修改已经用完了，客户王总又要改颜色和字体。不想无限免费改下去。
Client says adding a blog section is 'a tiny change, the last agency threw that stuff in.' I quoted $1,800 for it.
I run social media for a restaurant group on a $1,500/month retainer that covers 12 posts a month. The owner, Luca, now wants me to also answer all their Instagram DMs and Google reviews every day.
I'm a freelance photographer. A friend of a friend, Priya, wants product photos for her candle shop and asked for 'mates rates', half my usual $900 day rate, since we know people in common.

I've done bookkeeping for a small landscaping company for 18 months at $600 a month. The owner, Gary, has paid late five of the last six months, August's invoice is still unpaid, and he keeps adding payroll questions that aren't in our agreement. I want to end it.
朋友小周介绍了一个做高端茶叶的客户林总，想让我做他们的抖音短视频代运营。我专做小红书图文，短视频不擅长，不想硬接。

I'm a freelance bookkeeper for a dental practice, $800 a month for the monthly books. The practice manager, Lisa, messaged 'quick favour, can you pull together a cash flow forecast for our bank meeting next Wednesday?' That's a good six hours of work.

I'm a freelance web developer on a $2,000/month maintenance retainer with an online furniture store. The owner, Mark, has started texting me at 10pm and on Sundays and expects a reply within the hour. Our agreement says support is weekdays 9 to 6.
My manager Jordan Slacks me on weekends with 'quick questions'. I want to stop answering until Monday without it hurting my review.
每次家庭聚会，我大姨都当着所有人的面问我什么时候结婚、一个月挣多少。我28岁，想提前私下跟她说清楚。
Told my best friend I can't do 1am phone calls about her ex anymore and offered to call on weekends. She replied 'wow, I thought you were my best friend, after everything I've done for you.'

Ma petite sœur Léa me demande de l'argent pour la troisième fois cette année, cette fois 400 euros pour son loyer. Je l'aime mais je ne veux plus prêter, les deux premières fois ne sont jamais revenues.
My mother-in-law, Linda, has a spare key and lets herself into our house 'just to drop things off', sometimes while we're still in bed. My husband agrees it has to stop. I want to text her kindly.
我是儿科医生。表嫂经常半夜在微信上发孩子的照片问我该吃什么药，这周已经问了三次。我想以后不在微信上看病了，但不想得罪亲戚。
My boyfriend Josh and I moved in together in August. He wants to do something together every single evening and I'm running on empty; I need some nights alone. Nothing is wrong between us.
My dad keeps posting photos of my kids, 4 and 7, on his public Facebook, sometimes with their school uniform showing. I've mentioned it twice casually and nothing changed. I want to say it properly.
表弟在北京实习，这半年已经来我家住了三次，每次一住就是一个多星期。我家一室一厅，我和女朋友住，很不方便。他说下个月还要来。我想以后不留他在家住了，但不想伤感情。

I just got into a PhD program in Edinburgh, starting in January, so I'm moving from Toronto. My best friend Zoe and I have lived 10 minutes apart for 8 years. I want to tell her before I post anything.
我和老公决定离婚了，已经协商好。想在大学室友的四人群里说一声，免得她们以后问起尴尬，但不想被追问细节。
I'm pregnant (due in April) and want to tell my close friend Hana, who's been doing IVF for two years. I don't want her to find out from the group chat.

I'm leaving my accounting job at Deloitte on Oct 30 to run my bakery full time. My parents sacrificed a lot for my degree and they'll worry. We have our usual call Sunday but I want to text first so it's not an ambush.
我刚拿到一家大厂的offer，11月2号入职。最好的朋友小雨上个月刚被裁，还在找工作。想单独先告诉她，不想让她从朋友圈看到。
I've been diagnosed with breast cancer, caught early. Surgery is Oct 14 and I'll be off about six weeks. My manager knows; I want to email my team of 5 myself but I don't want lots of questions.

Last week I told my close friends' group chat that I'd been laid off. Most were lovely, but Jake replied 'lol enjoy the paid vacation, wish that was me'. It stung because I'm genuinely worried about money. He's a good friend, just clumsy. Should I say something?

I had a miscarriage last week at 11 weeks. I'd told my three closest friends about the pregnancy a couple of weeks ago, so they need to know. I don't want to talk about it much yet and I don't want them to be weird around me.
我和女朋友小林上周领证结婚了，决定不办婚礼，两个人去旅行就算了。爸妈提前知道，也支持。现在想在家族群里说一声，怕长辈们觉得没被尊重。
I sell handmade ceramic mugs on Etsy. A customer just DM'd me a photo of a mug that arrived cracked.
We print packaging for a cosmetics brand. Their 5,000 boxes will be 10 days late because our foil supplier is behind. Contact is Lena, their launch is Nov 20.
Ich habe einen kleinen Online-Teeshop. Eine Kundin, Frau Krüger, hat die Sorte Winterapfel bestellt (Bestellung 3087), die ist aber ausverkauft. Neue Lieferung kommt am 20. Oktober.
我在淘宝卖手工香薰蜡烛。顾客林女士的订单（尾号5816）顺丰物流9月22号之后就没更新了，今天快递确认丢件。她是买来送朋友10月3号生日的，还没来问。

I make custom oak dining tables. Customer Marcus was promised Oct 2 after I already pushed it once from Sept 18. Now the tabletop finish needs redoing and it'll be Oct 16. He's hosting family on the 17th.

I make a small-batch card game. 312 people preordered for early October delivery. The factory just told me the print run failed quality check and needs reprinting, so shipping moves to around Nov 13. Need to email everyone.

Customer Dana ordered a linen dress (#6203) on Sept 14 for a trip this Saturday. I emailed yesterday that it's delayed to Oct 5 because the fabric is late. She replied: 'This is ridiculous, I ordered it specifically for my trip. Terrible service.' The sage colour is in stock.

I sell leather wallets on my own Shopify site. Customer Ben emailed: tracking says order #2194 was delivered Friday but he never got it. Nothing on the doorstep, neighbours haven't seen it. It was $85.
我开网店卖儿童绘本。顾客张先生订了三本（订单尾号3392），其中《小熊的秋天》出版社缺货，要10月20日才到货，另外两本是现货。他还不知道。
Going to a fintech conference alone next week and I freeze up at the coffee breaks. Give me something to say to someone standing by the coffee.
每周一在电梯里都会碰到隔壁部门的李姐，我只知道她上个月去新疆玩了。每次都尴尬地各自看手机。
At my girlfriend's work party, chatting with a guy named Chris who's given me one-word answers twice now. How do I get out without it being awkward?

Meeting my boyfriend Arjun's dad for the first time at dinner on Saturday. Arjun says he's quiet and spends weekends restoring old Royal Enfield motorbikes in the garage. I want something to say that isn't about work.
First video call with my new team and I'm always early. It'll probably be just me and Inês, who's based in Lisbon, waiting for a few minutes. All I know is she's the data analyst.
国庆回老家吃团圆饭，我旁边坐的是表姐的新老公，第一次见，只知道他在深圳做无人机。我怕冷场。

At my neighbour's barbecue I just asked a woman I met ten minutes ago, Grace, when her baby is due. She said 'I'm not pregnant' with a tight smile and now we're both standing by the grill in silence. What do I say right now?
